typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	toReconControl_outputfilename as string (),
	startTime as string ()
}

source(output(
		TRADE_ID as decimal(38,0),
		EVENT_TYPE as string,
		CREATION_DATE as timestamp,
		SWORIGINALCOUNTERPARTY as string,
		COUNTERPARTY as string,
		NEWCOUNTERPARTY as string,
		STATUS as string,
		NOMINAL as string,
		ABS_NOMINAL as string,
		PRICE as double,
		PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION as string,
		PRODUCT_TYPE as string,
		PRODUCT_SUB_TYPE as string,
		PRODUCT_SUBTYPE_KEYWRD as string,
		BOOK as string,
		INTERNAL_REFERENCE as string,
		EXECUTION_DATETIME as string,
		COMMENTS as string,
		TRADE_CURRENCY as string,
		TRADE_DATE_TIME as timestamp,
		SETTLEMENT_DATE as timestamp,
		BUY_SELL as string,
		ENTERED_DATE as timestamp,
		ENTERED_USER as string,
		QUANTITY as double,
		RATE_INDEX as string,
		TRADER_NAME as string,
		CPTYATTRIB_BUSINESSTYPE as string,
		FIXED_RATE as string,
		CPTYATTRIB_IMAGINE_SHORT_NAME as string,
		CPTYATTRIB_RED_SHORT_NAME as string,
		EXERCISED_DATETIME as string,
		AMENDMENT_DATE as string,
		TERMINATIONTRADEDATE as string,
		EXECUTIONVENUETYPE as string,
		PRODUCT_EXTENDED_TYPE as string,
		PRODUCT_ID as decimal(38,0),
		CURRENCY as string,
		ECN_SOURCE as string,
		ECN_BROKER_BIC as string,
		REPORTINGEXECUTIONVENUETYPE as string,
		PORTFOLIO_COMPRESSION as string,
		TRANSFERTO as string,
		TRANSFERFROM as string,
		LEI_CP as string,
		EXERCISEDUNDER as string,
		PROCESSING_ORG as string,
		START_WEEK as timestamp,
		END_WEEK as timestamp,
		CREATION_DTE_SHRT as timestamp,
		CCPTY_FLAG as string,
		UNDERLYING_SWAP_CH as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FromCalypso
FromCalypso derive(NOMINAL = toInteger(NOMINAL),
		{Copy of CCPTY_FLAG} = CCPTY_FLAG,
		PRICE = toInteger(PRICE),
		PRODUCT_ID = toString(PRODUCT_ID),
		QUANTITY = toInteger(QUANTITY),
		{Copy of UNDERLYING_SWAP_CH} = UNDERLYING_SWAP_CH,
		FIXED_RATE = toInteger(FIXED_RATE),
		TRADE_ID = toString(TRADE_ID),
		ABS_NOMINAL = toInteger(ABS_NOMINAL)) ~> DataConversion
FromCalypso aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCount0
DataConversion derive(sAddDate = $startTime) ~> DerivedColumn
RowCount0 sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		LEI_CP as string,
		SETTLEMENT_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		QUANTITY as integer,
		EXERCISED_DATETIME as string,
		EVENT_TYPE as string,
		ENTERED_USER as string,
		TRADER_NAME as string,
		REPORTINGEXECUTIONVENUETYPE as string,
		CPTYATTRIB_IMAGINE_SHORT_NAME as string,
		PRODUCT_SUB_TYPE as string,
		RATE_INDEX as string,
		PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION as string,
		STATUS as string,
		UNDERLYING_SWAP_CH as string,
		FIXED_RATE as integer,
		EXECUTIONVENUETYPE as string,
		ADD_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		TRADE_CURRENCY as string,
		TRADE_ID as string,
		CREATION_DTE_SHRT as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CPTYATTRIB_BUSINESSTYPE as string,
		PRODUCT_EXTENDED_TYPE as string,
		PRICE as integer,
		CREATION_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		AMENDMENT_DATE as string,
		ECN_SOURCE as string,
		INTERNAL_REFERENCE as string,
		NEWCOUNTERPARTY as string,
		START_WEEK as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		ENTERED_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		TERMINATIONTRADEDATE as string,
		END_WEEK as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		PORTFOLIO_COMPRESSION as string,
		EXECUTION_DATETIME as string,
		COMMENTS as string,
		BUY_SELL as string,
		EXERCISEDUNDER as string,
		TRANSFERTO as string,
		CPTY_FLAG as string,
		COUNTERPARTY as string,
		ABS_NOMINAL as integer,
		PROCESSING_ORG as string,
		CURRENCY as string,
		CPTYATTRIB_RED_SHORT_NAME as string,
		NOMINAL as integer,
		TRADE_DATE_TIME as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		PRODUCT_ID as string,
		ECN_BROKER_BIC as string,
		PRODUCT_TYPE as string,
		SWORIGINALCOUNTERPARTY as string,
		BOOK as string,
		TRANSFERFROM as string,
		PRODUCT_SUBTYPE_KEYWRD as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		LEI_CP,
		SETTLEMENT_DATE,
		QUANTITY,
		EXERCISED_DATETIME,
		EVENT_TYPE,
		ENTERED_USER,
		TRADER_NAME,
		REPORTINGEXECUTIONVENUETYPE,
		CPTYATTRIB_IMAGINE_SHORT_NAME,
		PRODUCT_SUB_TYPE,
		RATE_INDEX,
		PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION,
		STATUS,
		UNDERLYING_SWAP_CH = {Copy of UNDERLYING_SWAP_CH},
		FIXED_RATE,
		EXECUTIONVENUETYPE,
		ADD_DATE = sAddDate,
		TRADE_CURRENCY,
		TRADE_ID,
		CREATION_DTE_SHRT,
		CPTYATTRIB_BUSINESSTYPE,
		PRODUCT_EXTENDED_TYPE,
		PRICE,
		CREATION_DATE,
		AMENDMENT_DATE,
		ECN_SOURCE,
		INTERNAL_REFERENCE,
		NEWCOUNTERPARTY,
		START_WEEK,
		ENTERED_DATE,
		TERMINATIONTRADEDATE,
		END_WEEK,
		PORTFOLIO_COMPRESSION,
		EXECUTION_DATETIME,
		COMMENTS,
		BUY_SELL,
		EXERCISEDUNDER,
		TRANSFERTO,
		CPTY_FLAG = {Copy of CCPTY_FLAG},
		COUNTERPARTY,
		ABS_NOMINAL,
		PROCESSING_ORG,
		CURRENCY,
		CPTYATTRIB_RED_SHORT_NAME,
		NOMINAL,
		TRADE_DATE_TIME,
		PRODUCT_ID,
		ECN_BROKER_BIC,
		PRODUCT_TYPE,
		SWORIGINALCOUNTERPARTY,
		BOOK,
		TRANSFERFROM,
		PRODUCT_SUBTYPE_KEYWRD),
	partitionFileNames:[($toReconControl_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> toReconControl
